en.headline: National Day half-price cinema tickets go on sale at 52 theatres
en.dek: The Hong Kong Theatres Association scheme cuts all regular ticket types on 1 October, with sales having opened at noon on Monday.
body: Half-price tickets for National Day screenings at 52 commercial cinemas went on sale from noon on Monday under the annual scheme organised by the Hong Kong Theatres Association.

On 1 October, participating houses will charge half the usual price on regular ticket types, including adult, child, student and concession fares. Private bookings and special programmes are excluded. Premium formats such as IMAX and 4DX are included where those sessions are scheduled.

Tickets are being sold at box offices, cinema websites and mobile apps. At the box office, each transaction is limited to four tickets; online limits vary by circuit. Some houses have said membership and bank discounts will not stack with the half-price fare, and gift-voucher redemptions may be paused that day.

Ming Pao reported that tickets for several popular titles sold out after sales opened. Ruby Theatre is scheduled to begin its pre-sale on 30 September. The association has run the National Day half-price day for a number of years as a territory-wide cinema promotion.

zh.headline: 國慶「10.1半價睇好戲」52間戲院門票開售
zh.dek: 香港戲院商會活動於周一中午起售10月1日半價戲票，涵蓋一般票種及部分特殊影院格式。
body: 由香港戲院商會主辦的「10.1半價睇好戲」周一中午起開售，全港52間商業戲院參與，國慶當日一般票種半價。
10月1日當天，成人、小童、學生及長者等常規票種均半價，包場及特備節目除外。IMAX、4DX等特殊格式如當日有場次，同樣納入半價。
門票於戲院票房、院線網站及流動應用程式發售。票房每宗交易最多四張，網上限額視乎院線而定。部分戲院表示會員及銀行優惠當日不可同時使用，禮券換票或會暫停。
《明報》報道，部分賣座影片門票在開售後已售置。寶石戲院預訂於9月30日起預售。戲院商會已連續多年在國慶推出全港半價睇戲。
